string.name: module_desc
string.value: 谎馆 LiarBar 单模块入口

string.name: lb_str_scaffold_banner
string.value: 脚手架：可导航四主屏，完整规则引擎尚未接线

string.name: lb_str_engine_banner
string.value: 人机本地 · 规则引擎开桌。胜负只认命。

string.name: lb_str_play_rollback
string.value: 出牌未生效 / 张数已纠正

string.name: _comment_lb_str_challenge_disabled_first
string.value: Value=第一手还没人出过牌. ONLY when no prior play exists. MUST NOT block challenge after first PlayLanded (see S18-6). MUST NOT be in-table tip primary.

string.name: lb_str_peek_hint
string.value: 按住看牌 · 松手收起

string.name: lb_str_dlr_chal_only
string.value: 手牌空了。可以质疑上家这一手，也可以过。

string.name: lb_str_dlr_play_named
string.value: {昵称} 出了 {n} 张，点了 {被点名}。

string.name: lb_str_dlr_windup
string.value: {质疑者} 开 {被质疑者} 这一手。

string.name: lb_str_dlr_judge_success
string.value: 有假。{被质疑者} 掉 1 命。

string.name: lb_str_dlr_judge_fail
string.value: 全真。{质疑者} 掉 1 命。

string.name: lb_str_dlr_redeal
string.value: 一圈没人推进。不扣命，重新发牌。

string.name: lb_str_peek_first
string.value: 侧边看不清点数。桌上仍看得出你在看牌。

string.name: lb_str_fill_ok
string.value: 已填上次：{n} 人 · {命} 命

string.name: lb_str_fill_fail
string.value: 填不出来就手打，不用登录

string.name: lb_str_silent_hint
string.value: 静默局：关催促、强震和嘲讽音。防窥和实况窗仍开。

string.name: lb_str_report_placeholder
string.value: 战报由引擎裁定。胜负只认命归零，禁止手牌多者胜。

string.name: lb_str_table_placeholder
string.value: 对局桌。看牌/出牌是叠层，不是独立主路由。

string.name: lb_str_challenge_placeholder
string.value: 质疑四拍。拍2 standoff 独立，不并进 reveal。

string.name: lb_str_tutorial_stub
string.value: 教学蒙层占位，不另开路由

string.name: lb_str_spectator_stub
string.value: 旁观互动占位，不改阶段

string.name: lb_str_challenge_dealer_enter
string.value: 上家这手——质疑，还是相信？

string.name: _comment_npc_challenge_true_false
string.value: DEPRECATED for entry NPC feedback. Entry NPC uses lb_str_npc_challenge_doubt / lb_str_npc_challenge_believe. Keep true/false present.

string.name: _comment_lb_str_challenge_true_false
string.value: DEPRECATED for entry button labels (PM 2026-09-14 lock). Keep present for reveal-layer / placeholder. Entry MUST use lb_str_challenge_doubt / lb_str_challenge_believe. Do NOT delete.

string.name: _comment_challenge_entry_abolished
string.value: PM 2026-09-14 reject lock: entry = 质疑|相信. Locked copy: lb_str_challenge_doubt=质疑 · lb_str_challenge_believe=相信. Buttons: lb_btn_challenge_doubt / lb_btn_challenge_believe. Art: art_btn_challenge_doubt/_on · art_btn_challenge_believe/_on. SFX: lb_sfx_challenge_enter / lb_sfx_challenge_commit (commit SFX only on 质疑). ABOLISH entry use of true/false/pass. ABOLISH design draft copy keys lb_str_challenge_commit / lb_str_challenge_trust (clash with SFX commit). true/false strings kept deprecated for reveal only. lb_str_challenge_disabled_first=第一手还没人出过牌 MUST NOT be in-table tip primary.

string.name: lb_str_penalty_no_redeal
string.value: 揭牌结算后未收牌重发

string.name: lb_str_out_still_act
string.value: 出局仍发牌/仍出/仍质疑

string.name: lb_str_first_hand_challenge
string.value: 第二人不可质疑第一手

string.name: _comment_lb_str_first_hand_challenge
string.value: S18-6/S17-1. 2026-09-15 semantic flip: FAIL if second player cannot challenge first play of round. Old value「第一手仍可质疑」abolished.

string.name: _comment_lb_str_reveal_claim_face
string.value: S18-24. FAIL if reveal shows claim-filled faces (e.g. claim A → all A) instead of real lastPlayRanks; empty ranks must not fake-play.

string.name: _comment_lb_str_reveal_too_fast
string.value: S18-25. FAIL if DRAW_TO_FLIP<800ms or REVEAL_HOLD<3s (lock 1000ms/3000ms; window 800–1200 / ~3s). SUPERSEDE 3500/5000/2000.

string.name: lb_str_challenge_no_pile_count
string.value: 质疑窗不见上家本手张数

string.name: _comment_lb_str_challenge_no_pile_count
string.value: S18-26. FAIL if AwaitChallenge pool last-hand backs invisible or count≠lastPlay.count.

string.name: _comment_lb_str_judge_not_top_start
string.value: S18-27. FAIL if judge/dealer lines not TopStart.

string.name: _comment_lb_str_center_top_claim_stack
string.value: S18-28. FAIL if CenterTop stacks claim/judge over timer-only.
